title: DCGAN
description: A generator (transposed convolutions, noise to a 64×64 image) and a convolutional discriminator, two models in one project.
descriptionZh: 生成器（转置卷积，把噪声变成 64×64 图像）与卷积判别器，两个模型在同一个项目中。

title: GPT-2 Small
description: Decoder-only Transformer: 12 causal self-attention blocks (768 dims, 12 heads), vocabulary 50257, context 1024.
descriptionZh: 仅解码器的 Transformer：12 个因果自注意力块（768 维、12 个头），词表 50257，上下文 1024。

title: LeNet-5
description: The classic convolutional network for handwritten digits.
descriptionZh: 经典的手写数字卷积网络。

title: LSTM text classifier
description: Token embeddings, a bidirectional LSTM, mean pooling over time and a linear head.
descriptionZh: 词嵌入、双向 LSTM、按时间步平均池化，再接线性分类头。

title: MLP
description: Two hidden layers with ReLU and dropout, for 28×28 digits flattened to 784.
descriptionZh: 两个隐藏层，带 ReLU 与 Dropout，输入为展平的 28×28 手写数字。

title: ResNet-18
description: Four stages of two basic residual blocks (two 3×3 convolutions and a shortcut), ImageNet 224×224.
descriptionZh: 四段、每段两个基本残差块（两个 3×3 卷积加捷径），ImageNet 224×224。

title: ResNet-50
description: Four stages of 3, 4, 6 and 3 bottleneck blocks (1×1, 3×3 and 1×1 convolutions), ImageNet 224×224.
descriptionZh: 四段瓶颈残差块，依次 3、4、6、3 个（1×1、3×3、1×1 卷积），ImageNet 224×224。

title: Transformer encoder classifier
description: Token embeddings, two pre-norm Transformer encoder layers, mean pooling and a linear head.
descriptionZh: 词嵌入、两层 Pre-LN Transformer 编码层、平均池化，再接线性分类头。

title: U-Net
description: Encoder-decoder from 64 to 1024 channels, skip connections joined by concatenation; padded convolutions keep the input size.
descriptionZh: 64 到 1024 通道的编码器-解码器，跳跃连接通过拼接汇合；卷积带填充，输出与输入同尺寸。

title: VAE
description: Encodes to a 20-dimensional Gaussian latent, samples it by reparameterization and decodes back to 784 pixels.
descriptionZh: 编码为 20 维高斯隐变量，用重参数化采样，再解码回 784 个像素。

title: VGG-11
description: Eight 3×3 convolutions in five pooled stages, then three fully connected layers (ImageNet, 224×224).
descriptionZh: 八个 3×3 卷积分五段、每段后接池化，再接三个全连接层（ImageNet，224×224）。

title: ViT-Tiny
description: 16×16 patches, a class token and position embeddings, then 12 Transformer blocks (192 dims, 3 heads).
descriptionZh: 切成 16×16 图块，加类别标记与位置编码，再经过 12 个 Transformer 块（192 维、3 个头）。
